# AI-Powered Commercial Insurance Startup Announces The Largest Publicly Disclosed Series A Amount Raised By A Black Founder (AfroTech)

AfroTech (Blavity Engineering). 2026.

## Key findings
- Headline: Harper announced **the largest publicly disclosed Series A amount raised by a Black founder**.
- **Dakotah Rice** is the **CEO** of Harper, an AI-powered commercial insurance brokerage; grew up in rural Alabama (father's nightclub, uncle's trucking company).
- Rice: Brown University, then Goldman Sachs, Coatue, Carlyle; Harvard Business School dropout.
- Harper launched 2024 with co-founder/CTO **Tushar Nair**.
- **$47 million in combined Seed and Series A funding** (announced Feb 2026), **led by Emergence Capital**; Y Combinator, Peak XV, Antler, 10X Founders, Fellows Fund, Outset Capital also participated.
